text: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with IV contrast. FINDINGS: Circumferential wall thickening of the descending colon measuring 5.2 cm in length with associated pericolonic fat stranding. Multiple enlarged pericolonic lymph nodes, largest measuring 1.8 cm. Liver: Two hypodense lesions in segment 6 (2.1 cm) and segment 8 (1.5 cm), suspicious for metastases. No ascites. No bowel obstruction. Chest CT (limited): No pulmonary nodules or masses. CEA level: 78.5 ng/mL (elevated). IMPRESSION: Stage IV colorectal cancer with liver metastases. Recommend multidisciplinary tumor board discussion and consideration of systemic therapy with potential for conversion to resectability.
